_comment: Phase 2 fixtures for Nordpart (invented company, invented people, .example domains). sentMessages = mail Nordpart sent itself (Sent Items). attachments = files; their bytes are generated in the tests from 'seed', so two files with the same seed have the same content. filingMails = incoming mail that carries those attachments.

sentMessages.subject: Oferta na pompy hydrauliczne PZ-40
sentMessages.bodyText:

Pozdrawiam
Tomasz
